speaker: thomas_pope
text: October is in the slit of the wall. If you are going to complain of it, complain now, while it is only weather.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not complaining. The coat is enough. The jaw is a jaw, and it has already had its dinner. This room does not get a second report of it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Burbage is in the passage. He has not come in. I am not going out to fetch a word he has not offered.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. A man in a passage is a man with his own cue. We have a bench and a rope and a pot, and none of them needs a messenger.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: When the end is close he will say so, and he will say it once. I have seen him spend a whole play on not making speeches to a room that is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will be a room that is nearly finished, and quiet about it. My next is mine. I am not borrowing anyone's to fill the wait.
